snippet.title: Dr. Panda Restaurant 2 - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Dr. Panda Restaurant is re-opening!
Download now
- Apple App Store: http://bit.ly/Rest2iOS_FB
- Google Play: http://bit.ly/Rest2GP_FB
- Amazon App Store: https://amzn.to/2uw5uc2

This time all the choices are yours! Make the pizza of your dreams, a pasta dish to rave about, or a soup so spicy your customers will breathe fire! Sweet or salty? Spicy or bitter? It’s up to you!

Find out more at http://www.drpanda.com
